score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: Merge metadata, post-merge workflow failure, #1245 final checks, and #1237 exact-head CI/Documenter results were read live from GitHub. The #1237 owner condition and PR body were read directly; its current workflow job list does not include Julia 1.10. Lane inventories were refreshed independently for both repositories. The local R CMD check log and artifact hash were retained. Style assessment remains a self-review and is not calibrated.

The #1237 owner comment and branch base were read directly; its current exact-head workflow includes Julia 1 shards but no Julia 1.10 job. Both repository lane inventories were refreshed. The local as-CRAN run reported status 0 with one missing-checkbashisms warning; the tarball hash and size came from the retained artifact. No PR, receipt, source, or owner worktree was changed.

calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
